burnedfileexplain:
After this function is enabled, copy the bin file and hex file (target.hex needs to be generated) and rename the file.
The renaming rule is as follows: \%3A
[$proj]\%3A Current project name
[$data]\%3A Current date. Year Month Day 
[$time]\%3A Current time, hour and hour
[macro]\%3A Value of the customized macro in the file. If the macro is not defined, The default value is space.
[$CRC]\%3ACRC checksum
In addition to the above specific fields, you can customize the file name. Custom file names need to have the brackets removed, otherwise the custom parameters will be recognized as macros and displayed as spaces.
